mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.3% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.3%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.5 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives higher corporate revenues and earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1500.0, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 110.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, which triggers risk-off sentiment and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in both personal consumption expenditures and residential fixed investment signal strong aggregate demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI and a stable or rising federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressure, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which increases equity discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when both CPIAUCSL > 207.0 and FEDFUNDS >= 5.2%, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment and a decline in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 137000.0 and UNRATE < 4.6%, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures and residential fixed investment signals robust consumer demand and confidence, which drives corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 55% of instances when both GDPC1 and RSAFS are rising, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
